asset: TRAKT exterior A6 - glazing owned by the exterior (single windscreen + door glass)

frames.a2: Blender/A2: Z up, +Y forward, origin = ground under the front axle, driver = -X
frames.unity_cab: Unity axes (x, z, y) relative to CAB_MOUNT_REF (= interior origin, CabPivot)

glass_model: single surface (thin-sheet shader), 4 mm (horizontal) outside the shell skin; the laminated pane is ~6 mm thick: inner face = outer surface - 6 mm along the true normal (normal_unity, includes the rake)

frit_on_exterior_glass_m.note: black ceramic band (frit_* geometry, Trim slot) on the OUTER side, single-sided (faces out). The interior prints the same band on the inner face (faces the cab) with these widths, so both sides see one consistent print and no light leak at the dash top

inner_face_grid_a2_13x49.rows: z from glass bottom edge to top edge (uniform)
inner_face_grid_a2_13x49.columns: surface parameter from left (-X) to right (+X), wrapping the corner arcs

L.object: GLASS_DoorL_LOD0 (child of DOOR_L_LOD0: moves with the door)

R.object: GLASS_DoorR_LOD0 (child of DOOR_R_LOD0: moves with the door)

shell_sections.note: cab shell outer surface in plan, per height (A2): front y, back y, half width, front / back plan corner radius (rounded-rectangle section, roof rounding included). The skin is wall_m thick inwards. The interior must stay inside (outer - wall_m) and behind the glass inner face; tools/blender/truck/check_fit.py tests it on the exported FBX files.

interior_contract: with the exterior present disable the interior CAB_Glass_Windows (placeholder windscreen + door glass) and CAB_ShellPlaceholder: the exterior GLASS_* objects are the only glazing (CAB_Glass = cluster cover glass stays)

windscreen inner trim (A-pillar trims, header, dash top edge) must end on the inner glass face = inner_face_grid_a2_13x49 (= outer surface - 6 mm along the true normal); visible opening z 1.94-3.12 m (A2), glass edge 1.928-3.132 m
interior frit band (ws_frit*): same widths as frit_on_exterior_glass_m.inside_visible_opening_m, on the inner face (inner_face_grid_a2_13x49 - 1.5 mm), facing the cab
door glass: interior door card window opening = side_glass outline minus the 35 mm black frame
